en: A vintage black-and-white image shows a formal avenue lined with bare trees, leading to a grand building surrounded by manicured gardens and a high hedge or wall. The bottom left corner of the image has the text "Bad Pyrmont", and the bottom right says "Schloß", indicating the subject is the Schloss (palace or castle) in Bad Pyrmont. The back side of the postcard includes German print and handwritten numbers, as well as the stamp for MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT, and the publisher name H. Schlitzberger, Hofphotograph, Bad Pyrmont.
